```{r}
# Helper functions
# Significant DEGs (padj < 0.05), sorted by log2FC
order_markers <- function(m){
  m <- m[m$p_val_adj < 0.05,]
  m[order(m$avg_log2FC),]
}
sort_fc <- function(m, decreasing = FALSE) m[order(m$avg_log2FC, decreasing = decreasing),]
# DEG table restricted to a gene list, sorted by log2FC
in_set <- function(m, genes) sort_fc(m[rownames(m) %in% genes,])
# Top and bottom n genes of a sorted DEG table
top_bottom <- function(m, n = 10) rownames(m)[unique(c(head(seq_len(nrow(m)), n), tail(seq_len(nrow(m)), n)))]

# Standard volcano plot of a FindMarkers table
volcano <- function(markers, title, y = "p_val_adj", pCutoff = 10e-6, max.overlaps = 30){
  EnhancedVolcano(markers, lab = rownames(markers), x = "avg_log2FC", y = y, title = title,
                  xlim = c(-2.5,2.5), pointSize = 0.5, FCcutoff = 0.25, pCutoff = pCutoff,
                  drawConnectors = TRUE, labSize = 4, max.overlaps = max.overlaps)
}
# Volcano plot that labels and colors only the genes in glist
plot_volcano <- function(table, glist, title, legend = "Highlighted genes", xlim = c(-2.5,2.5), ...){
  hit <- rownames(table) %in% glist
  keyvals <- ifelse(hit, "red", "lightgrey")
  names(keyvals) <- ifelse(hit, legend, "Other")
  EnhancedVolcano(table, lab = ifelse(hit, rownames(table), NA), x = "avg_log2FC", y = "p_val_adj",
                  title = title, xlim = xlim, colCustom = keyvals, pointSize = 1, FCcutoff = 0.25,
                  drawConnectors = TRUE, labSize = 4, max.overlaps = Inf, ...)
}
# Proportion test of each cluster, KO vs. reference condition (rows = conditions, cols = clusters)
prop_test_vs <- function(counts, ko, ref = "Ctrl", totals = rowSums(counts)){
  sapply(colnames(counts), function(cl)
    prop.test(x = c(counts[ko, cl], counts[ref, cl]), n = c(totals[ko], totals[ref]))$p.value)
}
# Convert human symbols to mouse symbols
matchMMUsymbol <- function(human_symbol){
  map <- read.table("/Users/ningguan/Partners Healthcare Dropbox/Ning Guan/Documents/Code/codes_Davis/src/Mouse_Human_GeneIDs_sub.txt", sep = ' ', header = T)
  map[match(human_symbol, map$hsa_symbol),]$mmu_symbol
}
```

## 1. Load data and merge samples
```{r}
dirc <- "/Users/ningguan/Partners Healthcare Dropbox/Ning Guan/Lab Work- Alexa Mitchell/RNA_seq/BPPNM_TF_KO_Flex/Cellranger Output/outs/per_sample_outs"
samples <- c(paste0("Ctrl-",1:4), paste0("Cebpb-",1:4), paste0("Arnt-",1:2), paste0("Xbp1-",1:2)) # sample1 ... sample12
objs <- lapply(seq_along(samples), function(i){
  counts <- Read10X(data.dir = file.path(dirc, paste0("sample", i), "count/sample_filtered_feature_bc_matrix"))
  CreateSeuratObject(counts = counts, min.features = 200, project = samples[i])
})
bppnm.tfs <- merge(objs[[1]], y = objs[-1], add.cell.ids = samples, project = "BPPNM TF-KO")
bppnm.tfs # 19,070 genes across 78840 cells
rm(objs)
# Add metadata
bppnm.tfs$Condition <- sub("-.*", "", bppnm.tfs$orig.ident)
bppnm.tfs$Mouse <- sub(".*-", "", bppnm.tfs$orig.ident)
```
```{r}
# Keep genes detected in >= 10 cells
gene_counts <- rowSums(GetAssayData(JoinLayers(bppnm.tfs), layer = "counts") > 0)
bppnm.tfs <- subset(bppnm.tfs, features = names(gene_counts[gene_counts >= 10]))
bppnm.tfs # 17220 genes across 78840 cells
```

## 2. QC
```{r}
bppnm.tfs[["percent.mt"]] <- PercentageFeatureSet(bppnm.tfs, pattern = "^mt-")
VlnPlot(bppnm.tfs, features = c("nFeature_RNA", "nCount_RNA", "percent.mt"), ncol = 3)
```

## 3. Seurat pipeline and Harmony
```{r}
bppnm.tfs <- subset(bppnm.tfs, subset = nFeature_RNA>300 & percent.mt < 5 & nFeature_RNA < 11000) # 17220 genes across 77782 cells
bppnm.tfs <- NormalizeData(object=bppnm.tfs) # Normalize each sample separately
bppnm.tfs <- subset(bppnm.tfs, subset= Epcam > 0 & Cd8a > 0,invert=T) # Doublet removal
bppnm.tfs <- subset(bppnm.tfs, subset= Ms4a1 > 0 & Cd8a > 0,invert=T) # 17220 features across 77680
bppnm.tfs <- FindVariableFeatures(object=bppnm.tfs)
bppnm.tfs <- JoinLayers(bppnm.tfs) # Join counts into 1 Layer
bppnm.tfs <- ScaleData(object = bppnm.tfs, features=rownames(bppnm.tfs))
bppnm.tfs <- RunPCA(object=bppnm.tfs)
DimPlot(object=bppnm.tfs, reduction="pca",group.by="orig.ident",shuffle=T)
```
```{r}
# Without batch correction
bppnm.tfs <- FindNeighbors(bppnm.tfs, reduction="pca",dims=1:30)
bppnm.tfs <- FindClusters(bppnm.tfs, reduction="pca",resolution=0.3) # Identified 14 Clusters
bppnm.tfs <- RunUMAP(bppnm.tfs, dims=1:30,reduction="pca")
DimPlot(bppnm.tfs, reduction="umap",label=T,shuffle=T,repel=T)+NoLegend() + DimPlot(bppnm.tfs, reduction="umap",group.by="orig.ident",shuffle=T)
```
```{r}
# Harmony over sample ids
bppnm.tfs <- RunHarmony(bppnm.tfs, "orig.ident",reduction.use="pca",plot_convergence=T)
DimPlot(object=bppnm.tfs, reduction="harmony",group.by="orig.ident",shuffle=T)
bppnm.tfs <- FindNeighbors(bppnm.tfs,reduction="harmony",dim=1:30)
bppnm.tfs <- FindClusters(bppnm.tfs, reduction="harmony",resolution=0.2)
bppnm.tfs <- RunUMAP(bppnm.tfs, dims=1:30, reduction="harmony",reduction.name="umap_harmony")
p1 <- DimPlot(bppnm.tfs, reduction="umap_harmony",label=T,shuffle=T)+NoLegend()
p2 <- DimPlot(bppnm.tfs, reduction="umap_harmony",group.by="orig.ident",shuffle=T)
p3 <- DimPlot(bppnm.tfs,reduction="umap_harmony",group.by="Condition",shuffle=T)
p1+p2+p3
```

```{r}
# Rename clusters and add grouping metadata
new_cluster_ids <- c("Mes Cancer 1","Myeloid","Cycling Mes Cancer 1","Epi Cancer","Mes Cancer 2","CAFs","T Cells","Cycling Myeloid","Cycling Epi Cancer","Endothelial","B Cells","Neutrophils","Plasma","Pericytes","Cycling Mes Cancer 2")
names(new_cluster_ids) <- levels(bppnm.tfs)
bppnm.tfs <- RenameIdents(bppnm.tfs, new_cluster_ids)
bppnm.tfs$celltype <- Idents(bppnm.tfs)
DimPlot(bppnm.tfs,reduction="umap_harmony",label=T,shuffle=T,repel=T)+NoLegend()
bppnm.tfs$orig.ident <- factor(bppnm.tfs$orig.ident, levels = samples)
bppnm.tfs$Condition <- factor(bppnm.tfs$Condition, levels=c("Ctrl",kos))
bppnm.tfs$EMT <- ifelse(bppnm.tfs$celltype %in% mes_clusters,"Mesenchymal",ifelse(bppnm.tfs$celltype %in% epi_clusters,"Epithelial",as.character(bppnm.tfs$celltype)))
bppnm.tfs$Group <- paste(bppnm.tfs$Condition, bppnm.tfs$EMT)               # e.g. "Ctrl Mesenchymal", "Cebpb CAFs"
bppnm.tfs$Group_celltype <- paste(bppnm.tfs$Condition, bppnm.tfs$celltype) # e.g. "Ctrl Mes Cancer 1"
saveRDS(bppnm.tfs,file.path(dir,"Analysis/bppnm.tfs.rds"))
```

## 5. Tumor cells: Ctrl vs. TF-KO differential expression
```{r}
# DE per KO vs. Ctrl: Mes Cancer 1, Epi Cancer, all Mes clusters, all Epi clusters
Idents(bppnm.tfs) <- "Group_celltype"
de_tumor <- function(ko){
  run <- function(id1, id2) order_markers(FindMarkers(bppnm.tfs, ident.1=id1, ident.2=id2, logfc.threshold=0.25, min.pct=0.25))
  list(Mes1 = run(paste(ko,"Mes Cancer 1"), "Ctrl Mes Cancer 1"),
       Epi1 = run(paste(ko,"Epi Cancer"), "Ctrl Epi Cancer"),
       Mes  = run(paste(ko, mes_clusters), paste("Ctrl", mes_clusters)),
       Epi  = run(paste(ko, epi_clusters), paste("Ctrl", epi_clusters)))
}
tumor_de <- lapply(setNames(nm = kos), de_tumor)
# One workbook per KO, e.g. gene_lists_Cebpb_vs_Ctrl.xlsx with sheets Cebpb_vs_Ctrl_Mes1 / _Epi1 / _Mes / _Epi
for (ko in kos){
  write.xlsx(setNames(tumor_de[[ko]], paste0(ko, "_vs_Ctrl_", names(tumor_de[[ko]]))),
             file=file.path(dir, paste0("Analysis/gene_lists_", ko, "_vs_Ctrl.xlsx")), rowNames=T)
}
# Top 10 up/down genes of each KO, combined
mes.delist <- unique(unlist(lapply(tumor_de, function(x) top_bottom(x$Mes))))
epi.delist <- unique(unlist(lapply(tumor_de, function(x) top_bottom(x$Epi))))
```
```{r}
# Volcano plot of IFNg/IFNa response and MHC genes, Cebpb vs. Ctrl Mes Cancer 1
mes1 <- tumor_de$Cebpb$Mes1
mhc <- grep("H2", rownames(mes1), fixed=TRUE, value=TRUE)
plot_volcano(mes1, c(ifng_ifna, mhc, "Fosl1"), "Mes Cancer 1 Cebpb vs. Ctrl IFN Response", legend="IFN response")
```
```{r}
# EnrichR: genes up in Cebpb-KO Mes Cancer 1
dbs <- c("MSigDB_Hallmark_2020","KEGG_2021_Human")
enriched <- enrichr(rownames(mes1[mes1$avg_log2FC>0,]), dbs)
enriched[["MSigDB_Hallmark_2020"]]
plotEnrich(enriched[[1]], showTerms = 20, numChar = 40, y = "Count", orderBy = "P.value")
```

### 7a. Macrophages and myeloid cells
```{r}
# Macrophage DE: each KO vs. Ctrl
macrophages <- subset(immune, subset=subcluster %in% mac_subclusters)
Idents(macrophages) <- "Condition"
mac_de <- lapply(setNames(nm = kos), function(ko) FindMarkers(macrophages, ident.1=ko, ident.2="Ctrl", logfc.threshold = 0.25, min.pct = 0.25))
mac.markers <- mac_de$Cebpb
shared.up <- intersect(rownames(mac_de$Cebpb[mac_de$Cebpb$avg_log2FC>0,]),rownames(mac_de$Arnt[mac_de$Arnt$avg_log2FC>0,]))
shared.down <- intersect(rownames(mac_de$Cebpb[mac_de$Cebpb$avg_log2FC<0,]),rownames(mac_de$Arnt[mac_de$Arnt$avg_log2FC<0,]))
shared <- mac.markers[rownames(mac.markers) %in% c(shared.down,shared.up),]
volcano(mac.markers, "Cebpb-KO vs. Ctrl Macrophage DE Genes")
genesets <- c(setNames(lapply(mac_de, sort_fc), paste0(kos, "_vs_Ctrl")), list("Shared_Cebpb_Arnt"=sort_fc(shared)))
write.xlsx(genesets,file.path(dir,"Analysis/Macrophage_Conditions_DGE.xlsx"),rowNames=T)
```

```{r}
# Macrophage polarization scores (Cheng et al. Cell 2021 signatures)

sigs <- list(Pro_Inflammatory  = matchMMUsymbol(mac.signatures$M1[1:16])[2:16],

             Angiogenesis      = matchMMUsymbol(mac.signatures$Angiogenesis[1:25]),
             Phagocytosis      = matchMMUsymbol(mac.signatures$Phagocytosis[1:4]))
for (s in names(sigs)){

  colnames(macrophages@meta.data)[colnames(macrophages@meta.data) == paste0(s, "1")] <- paste0(s, ".score")
}

DotPlot(macrophages,features=c(paste0(names(sigs), ".score"),"Il6"))+theme(axis.text.x=element_text(angle=90, vjust=0.5,hjust=0.5))
```

```{r}
# Correlation between myeloid infiltration and cancer cluster % across samples
sample_ident <- as.data.frame.matrix(table(bppnm.tfs$orig.ident, bppnm.tfs$celltype))
cancer_ident <- sample_ident[cancer_clusters]
cancer_ident <- cancer_ident/rowSums(cancer_ident)
myeloid_ident <- as.data.frame.matrix(table(myeloid$orig.ident, myeloid$subcluster))
myeloid_ident <- myeloid_ident/rowSums(sample_ident)[rownames(myeloid_ident)]
coef <- p_value <- r <- array(dim=c(ncol(myeloid_ident),ncol(cancer_ident)),
                              dimnames=list(colnames(myeloid_ident),colnames(cancer_ident)))
for (i in colnames(myeloid_ident)){
  for (j in colnames(cancer_ident)){
    s <- summary(lm(myeloid_ident[[i]] ~ cancer_ident[[j]]))
    coef[i,j] <- s$coef[2,1]
    p_value[i,j] <- s$coef[2,4]
    r[i,j] <- sign(coef[i,j]) * sqrt(max(s$adj.r.squared, 0)) # signed r from adjusted R^2
  }
}
heatmap1 <- pheatmap(r,color = colorRampPalette(c("navy", "white", "red"))(50),breaks=seq(-1,1,length.out=50))
pheatmap(coef[heatmap1$tree_row$order,heatmap1$tree_col$order], color=colorRampPalette(c("navy", "white", "red"))(50),cluster_cols = F,cluster_rows=F,breaks=seq(-0.5,0.5,length.out=50))
```

## 12. CellChat
```{r}
library(CellChat)
data.dir <- file.path(dir, "CellChat")
dir.create(data.dir, showWarnings = FALSE)
CellChatDB.use <- subsetDB(CellChatDB.mouse)
options(future.globals.maxSize=4000000000)
future::plan("multisession", workers = 4) # do parallel
# Build and run CellChat for one condition, labelled by CellChat_cluster
run_cellchat <- function(sobject){
  Idents(sobject) <- "CellChat_cluster"
  labels <- Idents(sobject)
  meta <- data.frame(labels=labels, samples=as.factor(sobject$orig.ident), row.names=names(labels))
  cc <- createCellChat(object = sobject[["RNA"]]$data, meta = meta, group.by = "labels")
  cc@DB <- CellChatDB.use
  cc <- subsetData(cc)
  cc <- identifyOverExpressedGenes(cc)
  cc <- identifyOverExpressedInteractions(cc) # Ctrl: 2142, Cebpb: 2186 signaling pairs
  cc <- computeCommunProb(cc, type = "triMean")
  cc <- filterCommunication(cc, min.cells = 10)
  cc <- computeCommunProbPathway(cc)
  cc <- aggregateNet(cc)
  netAnalysis_computeCentrality(cc, slot.name = "netP")
}
cellchat <- list()
for (cond in c("Ctrl","Cebpb","Arnt")){
  cellchat[[cond]] <- run_cellchat(subset(bppnm.tfs, subset = Condition == cond))
  saveRDS(cellchat[[cond]], file=file.path(data.dir, paste0("cellchat_", tolower(cond), "_whole.rds")))
}
```

```{r}
rna_down <- intersect(rownames(mes_cebpb[mes_cebpb$avg_log2FC<0,]),rownames(mes_arnt[mes_arnt$avg_log2FC<0,]))
```

```{r}
# Fraction of Cebpb-bound genes that are up in Ctrl Mes vs. Epi
```

```{r}
# Hallmark pathways of Cebpb-bound Mes vs. Epi DEGs
tag_pathway <- function(tab, set){
  x <- tab[rownames(tab) %in% hallmark_genes(set),]
  x$pathway <- rep(set, nrow(x))
  x
}
int2_cebpb_emt <- tag_pathway(ctrl_emt_cutnrun_stim, "HALLMARK_EPITHELIAL_MESENCHYMAL_TRANSITION")
int2_cebpb_promoter_pathways <- rbind(tag_pathway(ctrl_emt_cutnrun_stim, "HALLMARK_TNFA_SIGNALING_VIA_NFKB"),
                                      int2_cebpb_emt,
                                      tag_pathway(ctrl_emt_cutnrun, "HALLMARK_HYPOXIA"),
                                      tag_pathway(ctrl_emt_cutnrun, "HALLMARK_MTORC1_SIGNALING"))
write.xlsx(list("Int2_Cebpb_EMT_GO"=int2_cebpb_pathways, "Int2_Cebpb_Promoter_EMT_GO"=int2_cebpb_promoter_pathways),
           file.path(dir_cutnrun,"Analysis/Cebpb_CUTnRUN_vs_scRNA-seq_EMT_GO.xlsx"),rowNames=T)
# TFs among CUT&RUN / scRNA-seq overlap genes
write.xlsx(list("Ctrl_Mes_vs_Epi_CUTnRUN_TFs"=ctrl_emt_cutnrun[rownames(ctrl_emt_cutnrun) %in% epi_mouse,],
                "Ctrl_Mes_vs_Epi_CUT_Stim_TFs"=ctrl_emt_cutnrun_stim[rownames(ctrl_emt_cutnrun_stim) %in% epi_mouse,],
                "Ctrl_vs_Cebpb_Mes_CUTnRUN_TFs"=ctrl_cebpb_mes_cutnrun[rownames(ctrl_cebpb_mes_cutnrun) %in% epi_mouse,],
                "Ctrl_vs_Cebpb_Mes_CUT_Stim_TFs"=ctrl_cebpb_mes_stim[rownames(ctrl_cebpb_mes_stim) %in% epi_mouse,]),
           file.path(dir_cutnrun,"Analysis/TFs in Cebpb CUTnRUN and scRNA-seq.xlsx"),rowNames=T)
```

## 14. Export to .h5ad
```{r}
# Add immune subclusters to the whole object, then convert to AnnData
subcl <- immune@meta.data[colnames(bppnm.tfs),"subcluster"]
bppnm.tfs$Subcluster <- factor(ifelse(is.na(subcl), as.character(bppnm.tfs$celltype), as.character(subcl)))
saveRDS(bppnm.tfs, file.path(dir,"Analysis/bppnm.tfs.rds"))
adata <- anndataR::as_AnnData(
  x = bppnm.tfs,
  assay_name = "RNA",
  x_mapping = "counts",                   # Maps raw counts to adata.X
  layers_mapping = c(normalized = "data") # Maps log-normalized data to adata.layers['normalized']
)
anndataR::write_h5ad(adata, file.path(dir,"Analysis/bppnm_tfs_scRNAseq.h5ad"))
```
